questions.q: In SageMaker Pipelines, what determines the structure (the edges) of the pipeline's DAG?
options: The alphabetical order of the step names
The order in which you wrote the steps in the file, always
Data dependencies: one step's output properties used as another step's input
The instance type of each step
questions.explain: The developer guide says the DAG structure is determined by data dependencies, created when a step's output properties are passed as another step's input.

questions.q: What is the job of a ConditionStep in the example pipeline?
options: It compares an evaluation result with a limit and branches to if_steps or else_steps
It trains the model a second time
It creates the S3 bucket for the artifacts
It deletes failed executions
questions.explain: A condition step evaluates its conditions; if all are true the if_steps run, otherwise the else_steps, such as a fail step.

questions.q: How does a later step read a value such as accuracy from an evaluation step's JSON report?
options: By re-running the evaluation inside the condition step
Through a PropertyFile declared on the processing step and a JsonGet with a JSON path
By parsing the CloudWatch logs manually
By emailing the file to the pipeline
questions.explain: The processing step declares a PropertyFile naming the output file, and JsonGet(step_name, property_file, json_path) reads a value from it for use in a condition.

options: Permanently changes the pipeline definition
Trains the model until accuracy reaches 0.7
Deletes the pipeline after one run
Runs the existing definition with the parameter default overridden for this execution
questions.explain: Parameters have defaults in the definition, and start lets you override them for a single execution.

questions.q: What does enabling caching (CacheConfig) on a step do?
options: Encrypts the step's outputs
Reuses the result of a previous successful run of the step with the same arguments
Makes the step run twice for safety
Keeps the instances running between executions
questions.explain: With caching, if a matching successful execution exists within the expiry window, the pipeline reuses its results instead of recomputing the step.
